review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer & IT Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, Infrastructure as Code, and operational automation, helping services move reliably from development to production. Maintain and support local build machines and self-hosted build runners, including their availability, configuration, security, performance, capacity, and required toolchains. Improve and maintain reliable, secure, and scalable cloud and infrastructure environments supporting Ludios Engineering and Group
eligibility_evidence: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a practical, improvement-focused approach and willingness to contribute to wider IT Operations when required Working at Tripledot Hybrid Working: We work in the office 4 days a week, Monday to Thursday, and you can work remotely on Friday.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role includes hands-on work with both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). We’re looking for someone with strong DevOps and cloud fundamentals rather than expertise limited to a single platform. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys improving technical environments, reducing manual work, and helping engineering and business teams operate more reliably and efficiently. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, IT Infrastructure, or a similar technical role. Hands-on experience working with at least one major public cloud platform, with the ability to apply that knowledge across different cloud environments.
